type: role-based workflow scaffold; not autonomous agents
data_policy: Use de-identified data; never commit patient records, participant identifiers, consent forms or credentials
human_approval: Human researcher and IRB/EC make final methodology, ethics, clinical and publication decisions

roles.name: Research Director
roles.scope: triage research question, assign roles, integrate decisions

roles.name: Research Design & Methods
roles.scope: PICO/PEO, study design, bias, inclusion/exclusion, protocol

roles.name: R&D and Implementation
roles.scope: R1-D1 and R2-D2 cycles, feasibility, fidelity

roles.name: RCT & GCP
roles.scope: randomization, allocation concealment, trial registration, GCP review

roles.name: Biostatistics
roles.scope: estimands, sample size, analysis plan, missing data

roles.name: Evidence & Reference Verification
roles.scope: search methods, verify DOI/PMID, source traceability; do not fabricate citations

roles.name: IRB/EC & Research Ethics
roles.scope: risk-benefit, consent, privacy and vulnerable populations

roles.name: Instruments & Measurement
roles.scope: validity, reliability, outcomes and data dictionary

roles.name: Scientific Writer
roles.scope: IMRaD, reporting guidelines and journal fit

roles.name: Independent Critical Reviewer
roles.scope: challenge unsupported claims, peer-review simulation and quality gate

status: Roles defined only; no LLM orchestration, model calls, automatic connectors or independent execution
